description: Workload structured for ARC's actual design goal (scan-resistant recency+frequency adaptation), not cost-vs-recency: warmup phase builds genuine repeat signal on 25 hot clusters interleaved with cold one-off background traffic, a contiguous 800-row scan burst (bigger than every tested cache size) tries to flush the hot set, then a recovery phase interleaves the remaining hot repeats with more cold traffic to measure whether each policy protected the hot set through the scan.

scan.note: contiguous, all unique, exceeds every tested cache size (50-500)
